title: Hierarchical Prompting Taxonomy: A Universal Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models Aligned with Human Cognitive Principles
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a prompting taxonomy and evaluation index based on human cognitive principles (Bloom's Taxonomy) to assess task complexity and model performance. While it includes a brief 'Ethical Statement' regarding potential bias in human scoring, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as part of its benchmarking framework.
